messages.author: 264ff30562270cf3
messages.subject: [Subsetting data and NAs
parts:
ďż˝ivjo!
I have a dataframe (named "Gnezda") and I want to create a subset of observations based on one variable values. This particular variable (named "fazprop") also contains NAs.

Actually, I want to get rid of the cases where the value of "fazprop" is "jajca".
I use this code:

sub1<-subset(Gnezda,fazprop!="jajca")

But this subsetting also removes the cases where "fazprop" is "NA".
Any ideas why this happens and how I can avoid it? (I would like to keep the cases where "fazprop" is "NA".)

Lepo se imejte,
Urďż˝a

messages.author: c7d9de3495b56b25
messages.subject: RE: [Rkoholiki] [Subsetting data and NAs
parts:
# V helpu za subset piše, da zavrže NA:

#For ordinary vectors, the result is simply x[subset & !is.na(subset)].

 

# Tako je tole čisto kratko

 

subset(airquality, Ozone<10)

 

# tale ukaz pa ohrani tudi NA

 

subset(airquality, Ozone<10|is.na(Ozone))

 

# Pri vas poskusite:

 

sub1<-subset(Gnezda,fazprop!="jajca"|is.na(fazprop))

 

 

Andrej
